subject: Post-call: SignalPath discovery — alignment, blockers, and go/no-go timeline
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@signalpath.ai>
Cc: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed mutual action plan (MAP)

Sanjay — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap of the discovery and a proposed MAP so we can align on stakeholders, timing, and blockers. Please confirm or flag changes.

Key pain / goals you reiterated:
- Production latency on retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) flows is unpredictable during peak hours; p50 fine but p95 spikes to ~1.8s which breaks live agent handoffs.
- Current infra spend is ballooning due to keeping multiple large-model endpoints hot for peak windows; objective is reduce steady-state cost by ~30% while preserving quality.
- Compliance requirement: model outputs for customer-facing logs must be retained 90 days and searchable; need auditability for sensitive PII redaction.

Success metrics (what SignalPath cares about):
1) p95 token latency <= 900ms for chat assist flows (99th percentile N/A initially)
2) Total inference spend <= baseline * 0.7 for the two primary workloads
3) Demonstrable audit trail + redaction controls for PII in outputs

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (draft):
- Milestone A (Pilot run): scoped RAG integration + prefix caching demo with 2 apps (support agent + knowledge base search) — Owner: Redwood (Irene/Chloe) — Target: 2026-09-10 — Success criteria: p95 <= 1.0s on pilot traffic, 15% cost reduction measured over 7-day window.
- Milestone B (Security & Compliance review): provide SOC-2 evidence & data retention configs; legal + procurement checklist completed — Owner: SignalPath (Procurement) + Redwood Security (Marissa) — Target: 2026-09-20.
- Milestone C (Scale run): dedicated reserved capacity or autoscale config for production workloads, A/B rollout to 20% of traffic — Owner: SignalPath Eng + Redwood Ops (Ben) — Target: 2026-10-05.
- Decision point: go/no-go for production commit — Target Decision Meeting: week of 2026-10-11 (final decision by 2026-10-15).

Known blockers:
- Procurement needs an itemized cost sheet and terms (net30 vs net45) to approve budget.
- Redaction tooling: need confirmation of scope (customer-controlled vs vendor-managed redaction).

Attachments: attached draft MAP (rdw_map_draft_v1.pdf) and the pain-criteria workbook (signalpath_pain-criteria.xlsx).

Next actions I propose:
1) You confirm owners and procurement contact by EOD Mon 8/17.
2) I’ll schedule a 45-minute pilot kickoff for 9/2 and circulate an updated MAP + commercial stub.
3) Marissa will follow up with the SOC/Security artifacts and a short questionnaire for your security team.

If anything above is off, call it out and I’ll update. Otherwise I’ll treat this as our working plan and produce the updated map.

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed mutual action plan (MAP)

Thanks Irene — that looks comprehensive, appreciate the clarity. A few quick clarifications and adjustments from our side:

1) Owners: Procurement lead will be Priya Menon (procurement@signalpath.ai) — please include her on any cost/terms threads.
2) Pilot kickoff: 9/2 is tight for our infra team (vacation week for a couple folks). Can we aim for a 9/6 kickoff window instead? We want a week to prep telemetry access.
3) Target dates: we can target Milestone B (security review) by 9/24 instead of 9/20 — our security review calendar is heavier that week.
4) Success criteria: we like the latency targets but add a user experience check: mean human escalation rate from chat should not increase by >2% during the pilot.

Procurement request (high priority): an itemized cost sheet (line items: pilot hourly reserved capacity, peak burst pricing, token pricing estimate) and a short statement of support SLAs for pilot-only (SLOs for response time + incident escalations).

I’m CC’ing Priya and she’ll coordinate the procurement checklist. Once we all agree on dates and Priya has the commercial stub, we’ll schedule the decision meeting for mid-October.

Sanjay
VP, Product Engineering — SignalPath.ai
sanjay@signalpath.ai
